decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already fully records the main-to-sensor power and signal connector types, pin counts, and pinouts.
The same source message already establishes the SPS30 SEL-to-GND requirement in its existing INTRODUCE Event; no additional cross-Requirement MODIFY is needed.
The connector pinout identifies supplied rails but does not change which rails are monitored, their measurement coverage, or the monitoring hardware.
The sensor-board connector inventory does not change the standalone regulator, its capacity, source-selection behavior, or the shared 3.3V load requirement.
The JST-PH connector in the source is the sensor-board power input, not the battery connector, so the battery interface remains unchanged.
The sensor-board connector specification does not alter the AXP2101 battery or USB power-path topology.
The message selects connector types for the sensor board but makes no sourceability, availability, compatibility-substitution, or cost decision.
Assigning SDA and SCL signals to sensor-board connectors does not change pull-up resistance or location, bus speed, cable length, or series-resistor conditioning.
The sensor-board connector inventory does not change the selected ESP32 module or establish a new MCU breakout requirement.
The source message concerns sensor and display connectors and does not change the addressable LED supply voltage or level-shifter requirement.
The sensor-board connector inventory does not affect the BOOT button, reset connection, or associated capacitance.
The source decision does not alter USB-C enumeration, programming, or native USB data behavior.
